description:
Trick-or-treat yourself to a fresh batch of nightmares.

Dare you turn the page? The hit anthology series returns with another chilling installment of bone-rattling horror! Terrifying new tales arrive just in time to haunt your seasonal reading list!

Featuring top tier talent and a can’t-miss, brand-new Graveyard Club story from horror master R.L. Stine (Goosebumps) and artist Carola Borelli (Spider-Woman)!

THE FUTURE ISN'T WHAT IT USED TO BE!

Ripped from their adopted home of Third Earth, the ThunderCats Pumyra, Neko, Lynx-O, and Ligon find themselves trapped on the distant future world of Sixth Earth - a broken, dystopian planet ruled by a totalitarian police state, where cats are outlawed and hunted to the brink of extinction.

To prevent this nightmarish future from ever coming into existence, the quartet must find a path back to their own time - and that means infiltrating the government's omniscient surveillance grid and shutting it down. But what they discover at the center of the all-seeing network chills them to their very cores - and what they learn about a certain upcoming event will send shockwaves though the lives of every Thunderan past, present, and future!

ED BRISSON, the acclaimed author of Apex and ThunderCats Lost, joins special guest artist CHRIS CAMPANA (Red Sonja, Vampirella) for this pivotal 40-page one-shot that bridges two different worlds - and sets the stage for a universe-shaking crossover event that will change the course of ThunderCats history!

Featuring all-new original cover art by DECLAN SHALVEY, ENID BALAM, ALESSANDRO RANALDI, and CAT STAGGS, ThunderCats Lost in Time #1 will distribute all covers - including variants and limited edition incentives - randomly in a single Mystery Blind Bag offering!
